web.title: Remote Desktop URI scheme - Microsoft Learn
web.description:
# Remote Desktop URI scheme
## ms-rd URI scheme
Note

Copy

```
ms-rd:command?parameters
```

`Parameters` uses the query string format of key=value pair separated by & to provide additional information for the given command:

Copy

```
param1=value1&param2=value2&…
```

### Commands and parameters
Using `ms-rd:` without any commands launches the client.

# Uniform Resource Identifier schemes with the Remote Desktop client for Azure Virtual Desktop ## Available URI schemes ### ms-avd #### ms-avd:connect | Parameter | Values | Description | |-|-|-| | user | User Principal Name (UPN), for example `user@contoso.com`. | Specify a valid user with access to specified resource.
_Required in Remote Desktop client and Windows App_ | ``` ms-avd:connect?workspaceId=1638e073-63b2-46d8-bd84-ea02ea905467&resourceid=a0a0a0a0-bbbb-cccc-dddd-e1e1e1e1e1e1&username=user@contoso.com&version=0 ``` ### ms-rd Using `ms-rd:` without any commands launches the Remote Desktop client. #### ms-rd:subscribe | Parameter | Values | Description | |-|-|-| | url | A valid URL, such as [[https://rdweb.wvd.microsoft.com](https://rdweb.wvd.microsoft.com)](https://rdweb.wvd.microsoft.com/). | Specify a workspace URL. | ``` ms-rd:subscribe?url=https://rdweb.wvd.microsoft.com ```
